caption: The drawing depicts three metal objects placed against a plain, light beige background. The objects appear to be old and have a rusty brown and dark reddish coloration. Two of the objects are elongated, tapering metal straps, each featuring three circular holes along their lengths and a loop or eye at one end; one is almost straight, while the other is slightly wider and more tapered. Both have some surface texture suggestive of wear or corrosion. The third object, positioned to the right of the metal straps, is shorter and has an L-shaped form, consisting of a straight rod with a perpendicular extension at one end. All three objects cast subtle, soft shadows on the background, emphasizing their three-dimensionality.
title: Hinges and Bolt
